name: Omar Haddad
headline: Senior PHP / Laravel Developer
summary: PHP and Laravel developer with 6 years building marketplaces and billing systems. Currently exploring Python and Django in my own time.

experience.title: Senior PHP Developer
bullets: Lead a team of four maintaining a Laravel marketplace with 1.2M monthly visitors and 6,000 sellers.
Reduced checkout errors by 35% after moving cart state from MySQL sessions to Redis.
Rebuilt the seller dashboard as Vue.js components backed by Laravel endpoints.
Upgraded the codebase from PHP 7.4 to PHP 8.3 and introduced Docker-based staging environments.

experience.title: PHP Developer
bullets: Built the customer billing portal in Laravel, handling renewals for 30,000 hosting accounts.
Wrote MySQL reports on churn and payment failures for the weekly management review.
Added JavaScript validation to the signup and payment forms, halving support tickets about failed orders.
Migrated legacy PHP cron jobs for domain renewals onto Laravel's scheduler.
